internal.title: Incident Report: Checkout Service Error Rate Spike Due to Payment Service Error Injection
internal.body:
At 10:51 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified a 50% error injection in the payment service linked to the 'paymentFailure' flag. The flag was disabled at 11:11 UTC after approval, leading to a rapid recovery of the checkout service error rate to normal levels. The incident was resolved promptly with no further impact.

Timeline:
- 10:51 UTC: Alert received for checkout service error rate spike.
- 11:11 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection.
- 11:11 UTC: Proposed and approved disabling of 'paymentFailure' flag.
- 11:11 UTC: Flag disabled and recovery verified.

Next steps include reviewing flag management procedures to prevent similar incidents.

The issue was identified and resolved within 20 minutes, and normal service was restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
